pages.text: The first snow fell all night. White covered the hill before the cabin.
Nils wanted to sled down that hill. The sled was in the loft. He put on blue boots.
Nils stood before the loft ladder. Above it was black. "The loft is too dark..."
Something big loomed in the darkness. He stepped back.
Nils took off his boots, then put them on again. Only footprints circled before the ladder.
He just looked outside. The hill sparkled white, but his sled was still upstairs.
The sun went beyond the mountain. The hill grew dim. Not one sled ride today.
Grandpa climbed the ladder with a lamp. Light spread through the loft. "Come up. Let's look together."
Nils climbed. The looming thing was an old coat hanging up. Behind it was the sled!
The next morning, Nils zoomed downhill. Grandpa caught him below in both arms. Nils raised his arms. "Again!"
